mechanism_findings.identifiability: The adaptive complementary gauge reconstructed the executed additive action within tolerance in all nine paired cells.
mechanism_findings.reward: Anchor fallback preserved the five-percent held-out reward floor in all nine paired cells.
mechanism_findings.frequency_alignment: Only one Hopper optimizer replicate selected a trained checkpoint and exceeded the ten-percent canonical frequency-reduction gate; no environment reached the required two-of-three replicate gate.
mechanism_findings.optimization: Eight of nine candidates fell back to the anchor. Training-batch deployment projections did not provide a closed-loop reward-and-frequency acceptance test, and unconstrained reward actor updates degraded held-out selection paths in HalfCheetah and Walker2d.
mechanism_findings.decision: Do not expand this unguarded paired continuation. Preserve the adaptive gauge, but make deployment-frequency updates transactional against frozen anchor paths and abstain when the anchor is already feasible.
